title: Jim Cramer reveals 6 AI stocks to watch in 2026

content_html:
For most of the summer, investors pulled money out of chipmakers and data center names and moved it into health care, banks, and retailers. 

The AI infrastructure trade led the market for two years. This summer, it underperformed.

Jim Cramer says that phase is over. On CNBC's "Mad Money," the host declared that the AI data center trade has regained market leadership. 

He pointed to some events over a few days that changed the setup, naming six stocks driving the rebound. All six closed higher that session and are outperforming the S&P 500 so far in 2026.

Here is what Cramer said, why it happened, and what investors should watch before chasing the move.

Why Jim Cramer says the AI data center trade is back

Cramer's argument rests on one idea: These stocks did not fall because the businesses were broken.

The six stocks had posted smaller gains than financial, health care, and retail stocks for several weeks. Then, on Wednesday, Aug. 12, all six rose together in a single trading session. 

Cramer said the size of that one-day move made it one of the most important sessions he'd seen for the group.

More AI Stocks:

  • Bank of America tweaks CoreWeave stock forecast after earnings

  • 'Big Short' Michael Burry takes aim at surging AI stock

  • Intel's $20 billion stock sale has surprising upside

The sell-off had a specific cause. Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund, Situational Awareness, peaked near $45 billion in early July.

It then took margin calls from its prime brokers and sold its leveraged stock portfolio to Ken Griffin's Citadel at a discount, CNBC reported.

The stocks fell because a leveraged fund was forced to sell, not because the companies reported weak earnings. That's an important distinction. 

A forced sale says nothing about whether a business is doing well. It only says the seller ran out of room to hold the position.

The 6 stocks Cramer named and how far they fell

Cramer called the group "the fabled six fighting bulls."

The names are Nvidia (NVDA), CoreWeave (CRWV), Nebius (NBIS), Intel (INTC), Super Micro Computer (SMCI), and Lumentum (LITE).

Each stock fell sharply from its 2026 high once the forced selling began. Here is how much each one dropped, according to Yahoo Finance.

How the 6 fell from their highs

  • CoreWeave: Down 56%

  • Supermicro: Down 53%

  • Nebius: Down 48%

  • Lumentum: Down 43%

  • Intel: Down 42%

For context, the Nasdaq 100 fell just 11% over the same stretch. The six stocks were affected much more than the market, which is what a leverage-driven sell-off looks like.

content_html_zh:
今年夏天的大部分时间里，投资者都从芯片制造商和数据中心公司撤资，并将资金转移到医疗保健、银行和零售商。

人工智能基础设施贸易连续两年引领市场。 今年夏天，它表现不佳。

吉姆·克莱默说这个阶段已经结束了。 在 CNBC 的《Mad Money》节目中，主持人宣称 AI 数据中心行业已重新夺回市场领导地位。

他指出了几天内发生的一些事件改变了格局，并指出了推动反弹的六只股票。 所有六只股票当日收盘走高，2026 年迄今为止的表现均优于标准普尔 500 指数。

以下是克莱默所说的、发生这种情况的原因以及投资者在追随这一举动之前应该关注的内容。

为什么 Jim Cramer 说人工智能数据中心行业又回来了

克莱默的论点基于一个想法：这些股票的下跌并不是因为企业破产了。

几周来，这六只股票的涨幅低于金融、医疗保健和零售股票。 然后，8 月 12 日星期三，这六只股票在一个交易日中同时上涨。

克莱默表示，这一为期一天的会议规模之大，使其成为他所见过的该小组最重要的会议之一。

更多人工智能股票：

  • 美国银行在盈利后调整 CoreWeave 股票预测
  • “大空头”迈克尔·伯里瞄准人工智能股票飙升
  • 英特尔200亿美元股票发售具有令人惊讶的上涨空间

这次抛售有特定的原因。 Leopold Aschenbrenner 的对冲基金 Situational Awareness 在 7 月初达到了接近 450 亿美元的峰值。

据 CNBC 报道，该公司随后向主要经纪商发出追加保证金通知，并将其杠杆股票投资组合以折扣价出售给肯·格里芬 (Ken Griffin) 的 Citadel。

股票下跌是因为杠杆基金被迫出售，而不是因为公司公布的盈利疲软。 这是一个重要的区别。

强制出售并不能说明企业是否经营良好。 它只是说卖家没有足够的空间来持有头寸。

克莱默点名的 6 只股票及其下跌幅度

克莱默称该团体为“传说中的六头斗牛”。

这些名称包括 Nvidia (NVDA)、CoreWeave (CRWV)、Nebius (NBIS)、英特尔 (INTC)、Super Micro Computer (SMCI) 和 Lumentum (LITE)。

一旦强制抛售开始，每只股票都从 2026 年高点大幅下跌。 根据雅虎财经的数据，以下是每一项的跌幅。

6人是如何从巅峰跌落的

  • CoreWeave：下降 56%
  • 超微：下跌 53%
  • 奈比斯：下降 48%
  • Lumentum：下降 43%
  • 英特尔：下降 42%

就背景而言，纳斯达克 100 指数同期仅下跌 11%。 这六只股票受到的影响远大于市场，这就是杠杆驱动的抛售的样子。
